notes.title: Patch v7.0.0 and Game Stability Period
notes.notes:
[u][b]Patch v7.0.0[/b][/u]
The new patch is live! It includes 10 new craftable potions, a few new rings of power, stability updates, 3 new QoL game settings and various other fixes.
Check out the details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2004640/discussions/0/570371162116265424/]here[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6NY5W18.jpeg[/img]

[u][b]Game stability period[/b][/u]
From our perspective, the game is complete and in a good place. We’ve implemented the majority of what we wanted, and on top of that, we’ve added a huge number of ideas from you, the players, that come after original release.

To give you an idea, since the expansion release (in the last 40 days), we’ve received over 210 ideas, reported issues, and QoL update requests from you. Of those:
160+ were implemented (~75%), 27 were marked as low priority, 23 we couldn’t reproduce or were rejected.
Since the release, we’ve acted on most of the feedback and implemented over 1,000 smaller and larger updates across more than 100 game patches.

Nothing is ever perfect, but we’re happy with how things look now. 
In the period ahead, the game will not receive new content updates or major reworks. That said, we are still here to provide technical support, and smaller patches may be released if new fixes are needed.
To make support easier, we now have a [url=https://svarogsdream.wiki.gg/wiki/Svarog%27s_Dream_Wiki]wiki[/url] and a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2004640/discussions/0/570371162116247018/]technical troubleshooting guide[/url]. If that doesn’t help, just [url=https://discord.gg/SsQ2q2u6RT]reach out to us[/url]. 

We will find time to assist you!

notes.title: Patch v6.4.0 – Major Class Balance Update and More
notes.notes:
[b]Class Skill Updates[/b]
We’ve reviewed player feedback from both veterans and newcomers to identify class imbalances.

As you probably know, in the game, you can mix up to four classes from the 15 available. The question isn’t just about which class is strong on its own, but rather which ones are worth committing to in order to find skills that synergize with others from different classes.

With this in mind, our goal with the patch was not simply to buff some numbers, we actually added new skills to struggling classes to make them more interesting.

Among around 30 class updates, we are [b]introducing 12 new passive skills and 1 new active skill[/b].

Fire and Ice mages received the most attention as they really struggled in mid-to-late-game, but 14 out of 15 classes received some updates. Full details and our reasoning can be found in the thread [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2004640/discussions/0/591762021826965009/]here[/url].

[b]Achievements Rework[/b]
Most achievements can now be earned outside of Ironman mode.
Why? A part of playerbase felt restricted by Ironman-only achievements, so we made a compromise:
- 86 achievements are now available in all modes, including one for reaching any ending.
- 5 achievements remain exclusive to Ironman for reaching all five endings on ironman.

For 100% completionists, the challenge remains almost as difficult as before, but now all players can feel rewarded.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Q8ZJKin.jpeg[/img]

[b]Item Updates[/b]
Underperforming items received buffs, there are new options for lifesteal.
Item Critical chance now scales with weapon quality to make it more attractive.

[b]Clarity Improvements[/b]
20+ passive skills that require specific conditions (e.g., night-based or weapon-based) now display buff icons when full condition is met.
This way, if you're unsure whether a poleaxe counts for spear or axe buffs, you can always check the buff icon in the lower right corner.

[b]Fixes & Optimizations[/b]
Since the expansion’s release, we've pushed 120+ updates, including bug fixes, QoL changes, and performance improvements.  
We are at a point where all reported major issues have been resolved, and we are now primarily addressing low-priority issues and some QoL requests.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nL42Z4v.jpeg[/img]

6.2.4-6.35 Expansion patch notes are here: [[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2004640/discussions/0/591759986609142727/]link[/url]]
6.4.0 Full Class update patch notes are here: [[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2004640/discussions/0/591762021826965009/]link[/url]]

If you have any comments or questions about the updates, feel free to post them here or in one of these threads.

notes.title: Expansion Release: 30 Days of Community Challenges and Celebration
notes.notes:
The expansion [i]Return of the Old Gods[/i] has just been [b]released today[/b]! To celebrate, we’re introducing two community challenges!
They will last for the next 30 days and are primarily intended to create small opportunities for community collaboration in an otherwise single-player game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2982030/Svarogs_Dream__Return_of_the_Old_Gods_Expansion/

[b]Challenge 1: Svarog's Memory Fragments[/b]
In the expansion area, you’ll find 46 lost shards of Svarog's memory. Collect 35 of these shards and share a screenshot to qualify for the reward.
We had a similar challenge to this one a year ago during the game's release.
[b]Reward:[/b]
[b]Your name (or username) will be immortalized in the game[/b] on a hidden wall within the expansion area, revealed as part of an Easter egg.
[b]Additional Note:[/b]
- Pirated copies are not eligible to participate.
- We reserve the right to request adjustments to usernames if they are inappropriate.
- We won’t provide assistance with this, but sharing information about locations on forums is entirely allowed.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OE7Ra1E.jpeg[/img]

[b]Challenge 2: Community Faction Wars[/b]
During the campaign, you’ll be prompted to [b]choose a faction to support[/b]:
-[b]Order[/b]: House of Faith, House of Coin, or Free People
-[b]Chaos[/b]: Underworld Horde, Devourers, or Goblins
Each faction choice contributes 1 point toward either Order or Chaos. We’ll use Steam stats to track these contributions globally.
Who is winning is displayed on this page: https://www.svarogsdream.com/factions-event

[b]The Stakes:[/b]
At the end of the challenge, based on the community’s collective choices, we’ll reveal the winner: Order or Chaos.
-If Order wins, a special in-game world-event tied to Order will be permanently added to the game.
-If Chaos wins, a Chaos-themed world-event will take its place.

The losing faction’s world-event will be discarded forever. 

Both challenges end in 30 days, so don’t miss your chance to participate! 
Let the battles begin, and [b]may your actions shape the Svarog's Dream forever![/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VUlrfxe.png[/img]

[b]Recommended Content Creators[/b]

Speaking of the community, let’s highlight some of the content creators we’ve loved watching play our game over the past year or so, who have also shown interest in trying out the expansion.

Twitch:
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/kormakrtv]Kormakrtv[/url] A talented streamer and voice actor, he brings new life to games without voiceovers. He will be streaming Svarog's Dream on January 14th 1pm CET
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/psiax82]psiax82[/url] We loved watching his tactical rogue marksman run last time when he finished the game. He plans to stream the expansion in the near future.
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/kaustosis]Kaustosis[/url] He has been with us since the beta. He truly plays games without rushing, immersing himself deeply in the lore while always being humorous and charming.

YouTube:
Exceptional channels that helped promote the game:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@click4gameplay]Click4Gameplay[/url] Deep analysis and exploration of the entire history of RPG genre.
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@Splattercatgaming]Splattercatgaming[/url] A dedicated channel focused on shining a light on smaller studios, helping them grow in this day and age.

Small but exceptional channels dedicated to creating thorough reviews by genuinely exploring the game's content:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@balidorf8573]Balidorf[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@JotunWarrior]JotunWarrior[/url] These two put in the effort to reach all the game's endings before making a video, which says a lot about them. notes.title: Patch 6.1.0
notes.notes:
Patch 6.1 prepares the game for the upcoming expansion and introduces over 30 updates and fixes to the core gameplay.

In terms of the core game, the patch primarily focuses on QoL improvements.
Some notable changes include:
[list]
[*] A new option on the map to display faction ownership of each region in the world.
[*] Filters added to the log page for easier navigation.
[*] A new game setting to enable character comments about the environment, including warnings about potential dangers during nighttime.
[*] The ability to move all alchemy ingredients to the alchemy bag with a single click.
[*] A new way to rearrange skill slots by dragging them.
[*] The addition of a class name for combinations of two or more classes. 
[/list]
We’ve also implemented another set of custom buffs for enemies across the world, based on feedback from testers.
The lore in the almanac has also been updated to better align with the new story introduced in the expansion.

For a full list of all 30+ changes in patch 6.1, check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2004640/discussions/0/591759644586683304/]Steam forum post[/url].

There are also 18 new Steam achievements that can be collected through the expansion, starting on January 9th.

notes.title: Patch 6.0.0
notes.notes:
A long time has passed since the last patch, as we were primarily focused on working on the expansion. 
However, that doesn't mean we haven't continued polishing the core game. 
We have just released a patch with accumulated changes to the core game from the past few months.

There are over 30 improvements and bug fixes, you can view the full list of changes in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2004640/discussions/0/4632610393485763441/]this Steam forum thread[/url].

We have also reworked the core game architecture to prepare it for the expansion. However, this will result in a much larger patch download size than usual.

In summary:
[list]
[*] We further polished movement and controls.
[*] We made balance changes, focusing on buffs and mini-reworks for dexterity-based skills.
[*] We fixed almost all bugs reported over the past few months.
[*] The patch also includes extra polish and several performance improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Combat Update
notes.notes:
Goal of this free game update is to give players more options, make combat more fun and add more impact to actions.

Before we list what's new, we want to share another piece of news: the first expansion to the game has been announced for Q1 of 2025. The link is at the bottom of the page.

Back to the topic, here is the list of changes that this patch brings:
[list]
[*] 3 classes are split into [b]12 new classes[/b], featuring upgrades to core skills and new passives.
[*] Improved skill effects, rebalanced them, and reworking some to make them more interesting.
[*] Players can now [b]combine classes[/b], and skills are more independent of weapons.
[*] Added a new [b]hard difficulty[/b].
[*] Updated rings to support mastery updates.
[*] Added [b]ragdolls[/b] to enemies upon death.
[*] Added [b]trails[/b] to all weapons in melee combat.
[*] Added new sounds in combat.
[*] Made the [b]camera smoother[/b] and added better camera shake.
[*] Increased character movement acceleration fivefold for [b]easier controls[/b].
[*] Improved bow ranged combat animations.
[*] Added an option to enable character health above the character's head.
[*] General [b]UI improvements[/b] around the action bar.
[*] Added an icon to enable the action bar directly through the UI.
[*] Added new skill tooltips and a new mastery UI.
[*] Updated tooltips, help pages, intro pages, and others to reflect new skills.
[*] Added option to enable extra mastery slots.
[*] Added an undo button to mastery selection.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dzD7BfD.jpeg[/img]
Major fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed floating precision issues that caused problems with navigation in dungeons and the underworld.
[*] Fixed issues where sometimes AWSD controls would not be as precise as mouse controls.
[*] Performance improvements have been made around how content is loaded from the hard disk.
[*] Fixed some graphical issues that caused ground textures to appear in a worse resolution than intended.
[/list]
And much more! For the full list of improvements, check the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2004640/discussions/0/6678353284412905875/]thread[/url] on forums.
If you have any feedback on the combat rework, feel free to post it here or in the forum [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2004640/discussions/0/6678353284412905875/]thread[/url].

When it comes to the announced expansion, you can check it here and follow it if you find it interesting.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2982030/Svarogs_Dream__Return_of_the_Old_Gods_Expansion/

notes.title: Small game update
notes.notes:
Starting now, you can adjust the game difficulty in the game settings also while playing.

In addition, this patch addresses a bug where one game ending would not trigger properly in some cases, as well as a bug related to data about when the village is under siege.

Also we improved clarity and made additional enhancements for fighting with two Baba Jaga sisters.

notes.title: Performance patch
notes.notes:
We've refined the code to improve how content is loaded. Previously, we would load only the main content during the loading screen and then load what is needed during gameplay. This caused visual issues for players without SSD disks, as they could reach areas while resources were still loading.

With this update, the game will load most of the necessary resources for a few square kilometers around the player during the loading screen. This change will extend the loading screen by about 30-40%, but it will result in smoother gameplay.

If you experience any issues with game loading after this update, please report them.

Other patch updates:
-Resolved a bug where, in some situations, graphic game settings would reset back to default.
-Fixed numerous punctuation and grammar errors, thanks to multiple community members who proofread all the dialogues in the game. A big thanks to them!

notes.title: QoL and Bugfixes
notes.notes:
QoL / Balance:
[list]
[*] Doubled stamina regeneration speed out of combat.
[*] Archers will now receive an acceleration buff for 1 second after firing an arrow, making it easier to kite enemies.
[*] More buffs have been applied to late-game mobs in the far east.
[*] Werewolves to the far east will now work together to attack players if they wander into that area.
[*] If you have already traded with a trader, he will not greet you anymore, making the entire trading experience faster.
[*] Added more help for players playing on easy difficulty.
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where, if a player quit before the game was loaded, the game would save incomplete world status, causing some players to lose equipped items. If this bug affected you, contact us, and we can compensate you in-game for lost items.
[*] Fixed a bug where traveling to Iriy would make the player lose their following pets.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some enemies to disappear.
[*] Fixed a bug where, after a player finished the first phase of combat in the light game ending and then tried to switch to the other ending, it would not trigger properly.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the last option in conversations hard to click.
[*] Fixed a bug where the second part of the dialogue screen could activate even when the player moved away from the NPC.
[/list]

Bonus: Added a new set of names to the wall.

notes.title: Bugfix patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a few issues with the first Iriy interaction that caused some players to get stuck.
[*] Fixed bug where, for the 'path of non-doing' quest 1, a copy would not spawn properly.
[*] Fixed bug where the God at the end of the dark path would be untargetable to ranged weapons.
[*] Fixed bug where some enemy models would not spawn properly.
[*] Fixed bug where the headhog would sleep and not take tongues from bags.
[*] Fixed an issue with the oak hearth interaction with skills and passives which would icrease loot drops.
[*] Fixed a few grammar mistakes that were reported.
[*] Added more information to the game start message, explaining how Ironman mode works in this game to remove some confusion.
[/list]
